children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What can I discover in the Mondial Marketplace?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: The Marketplace can surface structured Creator projects, Entrepreneur company and funding opportunities, Service Provider services and relevant ecosystem profiles.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Is the Marketplace only for buying projects?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Project acquisition is one possible Creator pathway. The Marketplace also supports co-founder discovery, professional-service discovery, company and funding opportunity discovery, and relevant profile connections.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What Creator offers are available in the current MVP?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: The current Creator Marketplace MVP supports Full Buyout and Co-founder / Equity opportunities.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does Full Buyout mean licensing?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Full Buyout represents an acquisition and ownership-transfer pathway, subject to the applicable agreement.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I find Service Providers through the Marketplace?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. Providers can publish structured services, while relevant professional needs can also generate matching opportunities across the ecosystem.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can Investors find companies here?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. Relevant company and funding context can support Investor discovery, with deeper review moving into the dedicated Investor access and diligence journey.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does a match mean the other person must connect with me?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Matching indicates potential relevance. The appropriate parties still decide whether to continue.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can everyone see every project or company document?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Public discovery and controlled information access are separate. Sensitive information can require permission, confidentiality steps or another appropriate access process.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Is Marketplace the same as Messenger?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Marketplace supports discovery. Messenger supports communication and related actions once an appropriate relationship begins.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What happens after I find something relevant?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Mondial routes the connection into the appropriate project, provider, entrepreneur or investor workflow rather than treating discovery as the final outcome.
